scientific_domain: Indefinite Acoustic Helmholtz Scattering & Wrapped-Phase Receiver Calibration

synthesis_decision.rationale: [blinded_slot:candidate_b->antithesis] The limits are 3.0% relative error for both source amplitudes and field magnitude, and 0.020 rad circular phase error. Candidate A passed both unmodified public cases, with worst errors of 0.577%, 0.368%, and 0.000623 rad, and matched the reference forward field to roundoff. Candidate B stayed within all three limits when withholding entire quadrants or near-wall receivers (worst: 0.743%, 0.495%, and 0.000623 rad) and when moving the largest measured residuals to high-leverage or near-wall receivers (worst: 0.523%, 0.336%, and 0.000623 rad).
